mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND payment_status = 'pending'
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE payment_status = 'failed' AND created_at > DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (tenant_id, order_number, customer_id, appointment_id, resource_id, resource_type, subtotal, tax_rate, tax_amount, tip_amount, tip_percentage, total_amount, payment_method, payment_status, order_status, notes, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{orderNumber}, #{customerId}, #{appointmentId}, #{resourceId}, #{resourceType}, #{subtotal}, #{taxRate}, #{taxAmount}, #{tipAmount}, #{tipPercentage}, #{totalAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentStatus}, #{orderStatus}, #{notes}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET subtotal = #{subtotal}, tax_rate = #{taxRate}, tax_amount = #{taxAmount}, tip_amount = #{tipAmount}, tip_percentage = #{tipPercentage}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, pos_terminal_id = #{posTerminalId}, transaction_id = #{transactionId}, card_last4 = #{cardLast4}, authorization_code = #{authorizationCode}, notes = #{notes}, refund_amount = #{refundAmount}, refund_reason = #{refundReason}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(created_at) = DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AND MONTH(created_at) = MONTH(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT DATE(o.created_at) as statDate, COUNT(*) as totalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) as totalRevenue, COALESCE(SUM(o.tip_amount), 0) as totalTips, COALESCE(AVG(o.total_amount), 0) as avgOrderValue FROM orders o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(o.created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND o.payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY DATE(o.created_at) ORDER BY statDate

SELECT -- 客户满意度 (暂时返回固定值，后续可从appointments表获取) 4.5 as customerSatisfaction,
-- 服务完成率 (已完成订单 / 总订单) COALESCE( (COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)), 0 ) as serviceCompletionRate,
-- 预约取消率 (已取消订单 / 总订单) COALESCE( (COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)), 0 ) as appointmentCancellationRate,
-- 回头客率 (有多次订单的客户 / 总客户数) COALESCE( (COUNT(CASE WHEN customer_order_count.order_count > 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_order_count.customer_id), 0)), 0 ) as repeatCustomerRate FROM orders o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY customer_id ) customer_order_count ON o.customer_id = customer_order_count.customer_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(o.created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT DATE(a.appointment_date) as statDate, ar.resource_id as resourceId, ar.resource_type as resourceType, COALESCE(r.name, CONCAT('Resource ', ar.resource_id)) as resourceName, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) as orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(a.total_amount), 0) as totalRevenue, COALESCE(AVG(a.rating), 4.5) as avgRating, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.rating IS NOT NULL THEN a.id END) as ratingCount, 8.0 as workingHours, 85.0 as efficiencyScore FROM appointments a INNER JOIN appointment_resources ar ON a.id = ar.appointment_id LEFT JOIN resource r ON ar.resource_id = r.id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.appointment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND a.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY DATE(a.appointment_date), ar.resource_id, ar.resource_type, r.name ORDER BY statDate, resourceId
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT os.service_id as serviceId, COALESCE(s.name, os.service_name) as serviceName, COALESCE(sc.name, '未分类') as serviceCategory, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) as orderCount, s.price as originalPrice, -- 小计：package支付的服务计为0，其他按比例分配订单的subtotal SUM( CASE WHEN os.payment_method = 'package' THEN 0 WHEN o.subtotal > 0 THEN o.subtotal * (os.price * os.quantity) / -- 只使用非package服务的金额总和作为分配基础 (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id AND os2.payment_method != 'package') ELSE 0 END ) as totalSubtotal, -- 税费：package支付的服务不分配税费，其他按非package服务金额比例分配 -- 只在收费服务之间分配税费 SUM( CASE WHEN os.payment_method = 'package' THEN 0 WHEN o.tax_amount > 0 THEN o.tax_amount * (os.price * os.quantity) / -- 只使用非package服务的原价总和作为分配基础 (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id AND os2.payment_method != 'package') ELSE 0 END ) as totalTax, -- 小费：所有服务都按服务原价比例分配 -- 始终使用服务原价总和作为分配基础，确保分配总和等于订单小费 SUM( CASE WHEN o.tip_amount > 0 THEN o.tip_amount * (os.price * os.quantity) / (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id) ELSE 0 END ) as totalTips, -- 总金额：package只计小费，非package按比例分配剩余金额 SUM( CASE WHEN os.payment_method = 'package' THEN -- package只计算按比例分配的小费 CASE WHEN o.tip_amount > 0 THEN o.tip_amount * (os.price * os.quantity) / (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id) ELSE 0 END ELSE -- 非package：需要分配的金额 = 总金额 - package服务的小费 -- 按非package服务的原价比例分配 (o.total_amount - -- 减去所有package服务的小费 COALESCE((SELECT SUM( o.tip_amount * (os3.price * os3.quantity) / (SELECT SUM(os4.price * os4.quantity) FROM order_services os4 WHERE os4.order_id = o.id) ) FROM order_services os3 WHERE os3.order_id = o.id AND os3.payment_method = 'package'), 0) ) * (os.price * os.quantity) / -- 非package服务的原价总和 (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id AND os2.payment_method != 'package') END ) as totalAmount FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_services os ON o.id = os.order_id LEFT JOIN services s ON os.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN service_categories sc ON s.category_id = sc.id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.created_at >= #{startDate} AND o.created_at <= #{endDate} AND o.payment_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY os.service_id, s.name, os.service_name, sc.name, s.price ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT paymentMethod, COUNT(DISTINCT orderKey) as orderCount, SUM(itemAmount) as totalAmount, SUM(itemSubtotal) as totalSubtotal, SUM(itemTax) as totalTax, SUM(itemTips) as totalTips, AVG(itemAmount) as avgOrderValue, SUM(hasRefund) as refundCount, SUM(refundAmount) as totalRefunds FROM ( SELECT -- 支付方式：mixed订单使用order_services的payment_method，非mixed订单使用orders的payment_method COALESCE( CASE WHEN o.payment_method = 'mixed' THEN os.payment_method ELSE o.payment_method END, 'UNKNOWN' ) as paymentMethod,
-- 订单唯一标识：mixed订单按服务拆分 CASE WHEN o.payment_method = 'mixed' THEN CONCAT(o.id, '-', os.id) ELSE CAST(o.id AS CHAR) END as orderKey,
-- 单项金额（mixed订单特殊处理） CASE WHEN o.payment_method = 'mixed' THEN CASE WHEN os.payment_method = 'package' THEN -- package: 只计算按比例分配的小费 CASE WHEN o.tip_amount > 0 THEN o.tip_amount * (os.price * os.quantity) / (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id) ELSE 0 END ELSE -- 非package: 分配剩余金额 (o.total_amount - -- 减去所有package服务的小费 COALESCE((SELECT SUM( o.tip_amount * (os3.price * os3.quantity) / (SELECT SUM(os4.price * os4.quantity) FROM order_services os4 WHERE os4.order_id = o.id) ) FROM order_services os3 WHERE os3.order_id = o.id AND os3.payment_method = 'package'), 0) ) * (os.price * os.quantity) / -- 非package服务的原价总和 (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id AND os2.payment_method != 'package') END WHEN o.payment_method = 'package' THEN -- 整单package: 只有小费 o.tip_amount ELSE -- 其他支付方式：显示实际支付金额 o.total_amount END as itemAmount,
-- 单项小计（按比例分配订单的subtotal） CASE WHEN o.payment_method = 'mixed' THEN CASE WHEN os.payment_method = 'package' THEN 0 WHEN o.subtotal > 0 THEN o.subtotal * (os.price * os.quantity) / -- 只使用非package服务的金额总和作为分配基础 (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id AND os2.payment_method != 'package') ELSE 0 END WHEN o.payment_method = 'package' THEN 0 ELSE o.subtotal END as itemSubtotal,
-- 单项税费（只在非package服务间分配） CASE WHEN o.payment_method = 'mixed' THEN CASE WHEN os.payment_method = 'package' THEN 0 WHEN o.tax_amount > 0 THEN o.tax_amount * (os.price * os.quantity) / -- 只使用非package服务的原价总和 (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id AND os2.payment_method != 'package') ELSE 0 END WHEN o.payment_method = 'package' THEN 0 ELSE o.tax_amount END as itemTax,
-- 单项小费（基于服务原价比例分配） CASE WHEN o.payment_method = 'mixed' THEN CASE WHEN o.tip_amount > 0 THEN o.tip_amount * (os.price * os.quantity) / (SELECT SUM(os2.price * os2.quantity) FROM order_services os2 WHERE os2.order_id = o.id) ELSE 0 END WHEN o.payment_method = 'package' THEN o.tip_amount ELSE o.tip_amount END as itemTips,
-- 退款标记 CASE WHEN o.refund_amount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as hasRefund, COALESCE(o.refund_amount, 0) as refundAmount
FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_services os ON o.id = os.order_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.created_at >= #{startDate} AND o.created_at <= #{endDate} AND o.payment_status = 'PAID' AND o.appointment_id IS NOT NULL ) payment_items GROUP BY paymentMethod ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT o.payment_method as paymentMethod, COUNT(*) as orderCount, SUM(o.total_amount) as totalAmount, SUM(o.subtotal) as totalSubtotal, SUM(o.tax_amount) as totalTax, SUM(o.tip_amount) as totalTips, AVG(o.total_amount) as avgOrderValue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as refundCount, SUM(COALESCE(o.refund_amount, 0)) as totalRefunds FROM orders o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.created_at >= #{startDate} AND o.created_at <= #{endDate} AND o.payment_status = 'PAID' AND o.appointment_id IS NULL GROUP BY o.payment_method ORDER BY totalAmount DESC
